lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: Welcome back! I unearthed a curious stone in the vegetable beds this morning, and it set me thinking about <color=red>prehistoric</color> life.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: I've written five sentences about dinosaurs, though each has lost a word. Supply the most fitting word for every gap, and five new <color=red>books</color> will arrive in the library.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 1:
Dinosaurs <color=red>_____</color> the land for roughly 165 million years, far longer than humans have existed.
lines.hint: Not quite. The sentence stresses how long and how successfully they lived on land.
lines.correctText: Dinosaurs <color=red>dominated</color> the land for roughly 165 million years, far longer than humans have existed.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 2:
Most of what we know comes from <color=red>_____</color>, the preserved remains of ancient organisms found in rock.
lines.hint: Not quite. The words after the comma define the missing word.
lines.correctText: Most of what we know comes from <color=red>fossils</color>, the preserved remains of ancient organisms found in rock.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 3:
Triceratops was a <color=red>_____</color>, grazing on low-growing plants rather than hunting other animals.
lines.hint: Not quite. It ate plants, not other animals.
lines.correctText: Triceratops was a <color=red>herbivore</color>, grazing on low-growing plants rather than hunting other animals.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 4:
Many scientists believe a massive asteroid struck Earth about 66 million years ago; <color=red>_____</color>, the climate changed dramatically.
lines.hint: Not quite. The climate change was a result of the impact. Which word links cause and effect?
lines.correctText: Many scientists believe a massive asteroid struck Earth about 66 million years ago; <color=red>consequently</color>, the climate changed dramatically.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text:
Missing word 5:
Feathered fossils <color=red>_____</color> that birds are the living descendants of dinosaurs.
lines.hint: Not quite. Feathers on dinosaur fossils are evidence for the link, not against it.
lines.correctText: Feathered fossils <color=red>suggest</color> that birds are the living descendants of dinosaurs.

lines.speaker: Gus
lines.text: <color=red>Meticulous</color> work! Every gap is filled, and five new books are on their way to the library.

afterLines.speaker: Gus
afterLines.text: Thank you again. I like to think the sparrows in my garden are tiny dinosaurs, which makes weeding rather more <color=red>exhilarating</color>.
